# Contractor Insurance Diva

> Contractor Insurance Diva (by Contractors Choice Agency) provides commercial insurance for this trade in all 50 states. Coverage lines: General Liability for contractors, Workers' Compensation for contractors, Commercial Auto for contractors, Tools & Equipment for contractors, Professional Liability for contractors, Commercial Umbrella for contractors, Surety Bonds for contractors. A-rated carriers. Licensed in all 50 states — NPN #8608479. Founded 2005. Contact: 844-967-5247, josh@contractorschoiceagency.com.
